def ensure_parent(path: Path) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def prompt_overwrite(target: Path, member_name: str) -> str:
    sys.stdout.write(
        "Would you like to replace the existing file:\n"
        f"  {target}\n"
        "with the file from archive:\n"
        f"  {member_name}\n"
        "? (Y)es / (N)o / (A)lways / (S)kip all / A(u)to rename all / (Q)uit? "
    )
    sys.stdout.flush()
    answer = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not answer:
        raise ExitSignal(255)
    return answer.strip().lower()[:1]


def auto_rename_path(path: Path) -> Path:
    stem = path.stem
    suffix = path.suffix
    index = 1
    while True:
        candidate = path.with_name(f"{stem}_{index}{suffix}")
        if not candidate.exists():
            return candidate
        index += 1


def extract_members(model: ArchiveModel, mode: str, output_dir: str | None, patterns: list[str], assume_yes: bool, write_stdout: bool) -> None:
    selected = [member for member in model.members if match_member(member.name, patterns)]
    if write_stdout:
        for member in selected:
            if member.is_dir:
                continue
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(member.data)
        return

    base = Path(output_dir or ".")
    base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    always_yes = assume_yes
    skip_all = False
    auto_rename_all = False

    for member in selected:
        relative = Path(member.name) if (mode == "x" or member.is_dir or model.type in {"gzip", "bzip2", "xz"}) else Path(Path(member.name).name)
        target = base / relative
        if member.is_dir:
            target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            continue
        ensure_parent(target)
        if target.exists() and not always_yes:
            if skip_all:
                continue
            if auto_rename_all:
                target = auto_rename_path(target)
            else:
                response = prompt_overwrite(target, member.name)
                if response == "a":
                    always_yes = True
                elif response == "s":
                    skip_all = True
                    continue
                elif response == "u":
                    auto_rename_all = True
                    target = auto_rename_path(target)
                elif response == "q":
                    sys.stdout.write("\nBreak signaled\n")
                    raise ExitSignal(255)
                elif response == "n":
                    continue
        with open(target, "wb") as handle:
            handle.write(member.data)


def count_extract_summary(model: ArchiveModel, patterns: list[str]) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
    selected = [member for member in model.members if match_member(member.name, patterns)]
    files = sum(1 for member in selected if not member.is_dir)
    folders = sum(1 for member in selected if member.is_dir)
    total_size = sum(member.size for member in selected if not member.is_dir)
    packed = sum(member.packed_size or 0 for member in selected if not member.is_dir)
    if model.type in {"gzip", "bzip2", "xz"}:
        packed = model.physical_size
    return folders, files, total_size, packed


def crc64_digest(data: bytes) -> int:
    crc = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    for byte in data:
        crc ^= byte
        for _ in range(8):
            mask = -(crc & 1) & MASK64
            crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (CRC64_POLY & mask)
    return crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF


def rotl64(value: int, shift: int) -> int:
    return ((value << shift) | (value >> (64 - shift))) & MASK64


def xxh64_digest(data: bytes, seed: int = 0) -> int:
    length = len(data)
    index = 0
    if length >= 32:
        v1 = (seed + XXH64_PRIME1 + XXH64_PRIME2) & MASK64
        v2 = (seed + XXH64_PRIME2) & MASK64
        v3 = seed & MASK64
        v4 = (seed - XXH64_PRIME1) & MASK64
        while index <= length - 32:
            chunk = data[index : index + 32]
            for offset, var in zip(range(0, 32, 8), ("v1", "v2", "v3", "v4")):
                lane = struct.unpack_from("<Q", chunk, offset)[0]
                value = locals()[var]
                value = (value + lane * XXH64_PRIME2) & MASK64
                value = rotl64(value, 31)
                value = (value * XXH64_PRIME1) & MASK64
                locals()[var] = value
            v1 = locals()["v1"]
            v2 = locals()["v2"]
            v3 = locals()["v3"]
            v4 = locals()["v4"]
            index += 32
        acc = (rotl64(v1, 1) + rotl64(v2, 7) + rotl64(v3, 12) + rotl64(v4, 18)) & MASK64
        for value in (v1, v2, v3, v4):
            mix = (value * XXH64_PRIME2) & MASK64
            mix = rotl64(mix, 31)
            mix = (mix * XXH64_PRIME1) & MASK64
            acc ^= mix
            acc = ((acc * XXH64_PRIME1) + XXH64_PRIME4) & MASK64
    else:
        acc = (seed + XXH64_PRIME5) & MASK64
    acc = (acc + length) & MASK64
    while index <= length - 8:
        lane = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, index)[0]
        mix = (lane * XXH64_PRIME2) & MASK64
        mix = rotl64(mix, 31)
        mix = (mix * XXH64_PRIME1) & MASK64
        acc ^= mix
        acc = (rotl64(acc, 27) * XXH64_PRIME1 + XXH64_PRIME4) & MASK64
        index += 8
    if index <= length - 4:
        lane = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, index)[0]
        acc ^= (lane * XXH64_PRIME1) & MASK64
        acc = (rotl64(acc, 23) * XXH64_PRIME2 + XXH64_PRIME3) & MASK64
        index += 4
    while index < length:
        lane = data[index]
        acc ^= (lane * XXH64_PRIME5) & MASK64
        acc = (rotl64(acc, 11) * XXH64_PRIME1) & MASK64
        index += 1
    acc ^= acc >> 33
    acc = (acc * XXH64_PRIME2) & MASK64
    acc ^= acc >> 29
    acc = (acc * XXH64_PRIME3) & MASK64
    acc ^= acc >> 32
    return acc & MASK64


def hash_algorithms(mode: str | None) -> list[str]:
    if not mode:
        return ["CRC32"]
    normalized = mode.upper()
    if normalized == "*":
        return ["CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"]
    if normalized in {"CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"}:
        return [normalized]
    fail_command_line(f"Unknown hash method:\n{mode}", show_banner=True)
    raise AssertionError("unreachable")


def digest_string(name: str, data: bytes) -> str:
    if name == "CRC32":
        return f"{zlib.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF:08X}"
    if name == "CRC64":
        return f"{crc64_digest(data):016X}"
    if name == "SHA256":
        return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    if name == "SHA1":
        return hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()
    if name == "XXH64":
        return f"{xxh64_digest(data):016X}"
    raise ValueError(name)


def hash_width(name: str) -> int:
    return {"CRC32": 8, "CRC64": 16, "SHA256": 64, "SHA1": 40, "XXH64": 16}[name]


def scan_hash_inputs(paths: list[str]) -> tuple[list[ArchiveMember], list[WarningInfo]]:
    members: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    warnings: list[WarningInfo] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    items = paths or ["."]
    for item in expand_sources(items):
        if not os.path.exists(item):
            warnings.append(file_warning(item))
            continue
        if os.path.isdir(item):
            root = os.path.normpath(item)
            base = os.path.dirname(root)
            for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(item, followlinks=True):
                dirnames.sort()
                filenames.sort()
                rel_dir = normalized_name(os.path.relpath(dirpath, base))
                if rel_dir not in seen:
                    st = os.stat(dirpath)
                    members.append(
                        ArchiveMember(
                            name=rel_dir + "/",
                            is_dir=True,
                            size=0,
                            packed_size=0,
                            mtime_ns=st.st_mtime_ns,
                            mode=stat.S_IFDIR | stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode),
                        )
                    )
                    seen.add(rel_dir)
                for filename in filenames:
                    file_path = os.path.join(dirpath, filename)
                    rel_file = normalized_name(os.path.relpath(file_path, base))
                    if rel_file in seen:
                        continue
                    members.append(file_member_from_disk(file_path, rel_file))
                    seen.add(rel_file)
        else:
            rel = normalized_name(os.path.basename(item))
            if rel in seen:
                continue
            members.append(file_member_from_disk(item, rel))
            seen.add(rel)
    return members, warnings


def run_hash(paths: list[str], mode: str | None) -> int:
    members, warnings = scan_hash_inputs(paths)
    algorithms = hash_algorithms(mode)
    print_banner()
    total_size = sum(member.size for member in members if not member.is_dir)
    file_count = sum(1 for member in members if not member.is_dir)
    sys.stdout.write("Scanning\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"{file_count} {plural(file_count, 'file')}, {size_text(total_size)}\n\n")

    header = " ".join(f"{name:<{hash_width(name)}}" for name in algorithms) + "             Size  Name"
    separator = " ".join("-" * hash_width(name) for name in algorithms) + " -------------  ------------"
    sys.stdout.write(f"{header}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"{separator}\n")

    all_data = bytearray()
    for member in members:
        digests = []
        if member.is_dir:
            digests = [" " * hash_width(name) for name in algorithms]
        else:
            digests = [digest_string(name, member.data) for name in algorithms]
            all_data.extend(member.data)
        sys.stdout.write(" ".join(f"{value:<{hash_width(name)}}" for value, name in zip(digests, algorithms)) + f" {member.size:>13}  {member.name}\n")
    summary_data = bytes(all_data)
    summary_digests = [digest_string(name, summary_data) for name in algorithms]
    sys.stdout.write(f"{separator}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(f"{value:<{hash_width(name)}}" for value, name in zip(summary_digests, algorithms)) + f" {total_size:>13}  \n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"\nSize: {total_size}\n\n")
    for name, digest in zip(algorithms, summary_digests):
        sys.stdout.write(f"{name:<6} for data:              {digest}\n\n")
    if warnings:
        sys.stdout.write("Scan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")
        for warning in warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"{warning.path} : {warning.message}\n")
        sys.stdout.write("----------------\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"Scan WARNINGS: {len(warnings)}\n")
        for warning in warnings:
            sys.stderr.write(f"\nWARNING: {warning.message}\n{warning.path}\n")
        return 1
    sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0


def benchmark_row(data: bytes, iterations: int = 8) -> tuple[int, int]:
    start = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(iterations):
        compressed = lzma.compress(data)
    compress_elapsed = max(time.perf_counter() - start, 1e-6)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(iterations):
        lzma.decompress(compressed)
    decompress_elapsed = max(time.perf_counter() - start, 1e-6)
    return int((len(data) * iterations) / 1024 / compress_elapsed), int((len(data) * iterations) / 1024 / decompress_elapsed)

def merge_entries(existing: list[ArchiveMember], new_entries: list[ArchiveMember]) -> tuple[list[ArchiveMember], list[ArchiveMember]]:
    new_names = {member.name for member in new_entries}
    kept = [member for member in existing if member.name not in new_names]
    return kept + new_entries, kept


def delete_entries(existing: list[ArchiveMember], patterns: list[str]) -> tuple[list[ArchiveMember], list[ArchiveMember]]:
    kept: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    deleted: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    for member in existing:
        if match_member(member.name, patterns):
            deleted.append(member)
        else:
            kept.append(member)
    return kept, deleted


def rename_entries(existing: list[ArchiveMember], pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[ArchiveMember]:
    rename_map = {old: new for old, new in pairs}
    output: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    for member in existing:
        new_name = rename_map.get(member.name, member.name)
        output.append(
            ArchiveMember(
                name=new_name,
                is_dir=member.is_dir,
                size=member.size,
                packed_size=member.packed_size,
                mtime_ns=member.mtime_ns,
                mode=member.mode,
                data=member.data,
                encrypted=member.encrypted,
                method=member.method,
                block=member.block,
            )

def print_scan_warnings(warnings: list[WarningInfo]) -> None:
    if not warnings:
        return
    sys.stdout.write("\nScan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")
    for warning in warnings:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{warning.path} : {warning.message}\n")
    sys.stdout.write("----------------\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Scan WARNINGS: {len(warnings)}\n")
    for warning in warnings:
        sys.stderr.write(f"\nWARNING: {warning.message}\n{warning.path}\n")


def count_members(members: list[ArchiveMember]) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    folders = sum(1 for member in members if member.is_dir)
    files = sum(1 for member in members if not member.is_dir)
    size = sum(member.size for member in members if not member.is_dir)
    return folders, files, size


def print_mutation_header(existing_model: ArchiveModel | None, archive_path: str, new_scan: ScanResult | None, stdin_mode: bool) -> None:
    if existing_model is not None:
        sys.stdout.write(f"Open archive: {archive_path}\n")
        print_archive_overview(existing_model)
        sys.stdout.write("\n")
    if new_scan is not None and not stdin_mode:
        sys.stdout.write("Scanning the drive:\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"{scan_summary(new_scan.files, new_scan.total_size, new_scan.folders)}\n\n")


def save_archive_atomic(path: str, archive_type: str, members: list[ArchiveMember], compression_level: int | None) -> None:
    directory = os.path.dirname(path) or "."
    fd, temp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".sevenza_", suffix=".tmp", dir=directory)
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        write_archive(temp_path, archive_type, members, compression_level)
        os.replace(temp_path, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temp_path):
            os.unlink(temp_path)


def run_add_like(command: str, archive_name: str, input_paths: list[str], options: Options) -> int:
    archive_type = normalize_type(options.forced_type) or detect_type(archive_name)
    if archive_type is None:
        archive_type = "7z"
    archive_name = append_default_extension(archive_name, archive_type)
    existing_model = load_archive(archive_name, archive_type) if os.path.exists(archive_name) else None
    stdin_mode = options.read_stdin_name is not None
    new_scan = None if stdin_mode else scan_input_paths(input_paths)
    print_banner()
    print_mutation_header(existing_model, archive_name, new_scan, stdin_mode)
    if existing_model is None:
        sys.stdout.write(f"Creating archive: {archive_name}\n\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(f"Updating archive: {archive_name}\n\n")

    warnings: list[WarningInfo] = []
    if stdin_mode:
        new_entries = [stdin_member(options.read_stdin_name, archive_name)]
        files = 1
        folders = 0
        total_size = new_entries[0].size
    else:
        assert new_scan is not None
        new_entries = new_scan.entries
        files, folders, total_size = new_scan.files, new_scan.folders, new_scan.total_size
        warnings = new_scan.warnings

    if archive_type in {"gzip", "bzip2", "xz"} and (len([entry for entry in new_entries if not entry.is_dir]) != 1 or len(new_entries) != 1):
        sys.stdout.write(f"Add new data to archive: {scan_summary(files, total_size, folders)}\n\n")
        fail_system("E_INVALIDARG : One or more arguments are invalid", show_banner=False)

    if command in {"a", "u"}:
        if existing_model is None:
            sys.stdout.write(f"Add new data to archive: {scan_summary(files, total_size, folders)}\n\n\n")
            final_members = new_entries
            kept_members: list[ArchiveMember] = []
        else:
            final_members, kept_members = merge_entries(existing_model.members, new_entries)
            kept_folders, kept_files, kept_size = count_members(kept_members)
            if kept_members:
                sys.stdout.write(f"Keep old data in archive: {scan_summary(kept_files, kept_size, kept_folders)}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Add new data to archive: {scan_summary(files, total_size, folders)}\n\n\n")
    else:
        raise AssertionError(command)

    save_archive_atomic(archive_name, archive_type, final_members, options.compression_level)
    archive_size = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    files_read = files
    if archive_type == "tar":
        files_read = len(new_entries)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Files read from disk: {files_read}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {size_text(archive_size)}\n")
    if warnings:
        print_scan_warnings(warnings)
        return 1
    sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0


def run_delete(archive_name: str, patterns: list[str], options: Options) -> int:
    if not archive_name:
        fail_command_line("Cannot find archive name", show_banner=True)
    print_banner()
    existing_model = load_archive(archive_name, normalize_type(options.forced_type))
    sys.stdout.write(f"Open archive: {archive_name}\n")
    print_archive_overview(existing_model)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Updating archive: {archive_name}\n\n\n")
    kept, deleted = delete_entries(existing_model.members, patterns)
    del_folders, del_files, del_size = count_members(deleted)
    keep_folders, keep_files, keep_size = count_members(kept)
    if deleted:
        sys.stdout.write(f"Delete data from archive: {scan_summary(del_files, del_size, del_folders)}\n")
    if kept:
        sys.stdout.write(f"Keep old data in archive: {scan_summary(keep_files, keep_size, keep_folders)}\n")
    sys.stdout.write("Add new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\n")
    save_archive_atomic(archive_name, existing_model.type, kept, options.compression_level)
    sys.stdout.write("Files read from disk: 0\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {size_text(os.path.getsize(archive_name))}\n")
    sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0


def run_rename(archive_name: str, operands: list[str], options: Options) -> int:
    if len(operands) % 2 != 0:
        fail_command_line("Incorrect rename command", show_banner=True)
    print_banner()
    existing_model = load_archive(archive_name, normalize_type(options.forced_type))
    sys.stdout.write(f"Open archive: {archive_name}\n")
    print_archive_overview(existing_model)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Updating archive: {archive_name}\n\n")
    pairs = list(zip(operands[0::2], operands[1::2]))
    renamed = rename_entries(existing_model.members, pairs)
    folders, files, size = count_members(existing_model.members)
    if renamed:
        sys.stdout.write(f"Keep old data in archive: {scan_summary(files, size, folders)}\n")
    sys.stdout.write("Add new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\n")
    save_archive_atomic(archive_name, existing_model.type, renamed, options.compression_level)
    sys.stdout.write("Files read from disk: 0\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {size_text(os.path.getsize(archive_name))}\n")
    sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0


def require_archive_name(archive_name: str | None) -> str:
    if not archive_name:
        fail_command_line("Cannot find archive name", show_banner=True)
    return archive_name


def parse_switch(arg: str, options: Options) -> bool:
    lower = arg.lower()
    if arg == "--":
        options.stop_switches = True
        return True
    if lower == "-so":
        options.write_stdout = True
        return True
    if lower.startswith("-o"):
        options.output_dir = arg[2:]
        return True
    if lower.startswith("-si"):
        options.read_stdin_name = arg[3:] or None
        return True
    if lower.startswith("-t"):
        options.forced_type = normalize_type(arg[2:])
        return True
    if lower == "-slt":
        options.technical_list = True
        return True
    if lower == "-y":
        options.assume_yes = True
        return True
    if lower.startswith("-scrc"):
        options.hash_mode = arg[5:] or None
        return True
    if lower.startswith("-mx"):
        try:
            options.compression_level = int(arg[3:]) if len(arg) > 3 else None
        except ValueError:
            options.compression_level = None
        return True
    ignored_prefixes = (
        "-mmt",
        "-bb",
        "-bd",
        "-bt",
        "-r",
        "-an",
        "-p",
        "-ao",
        "-bs",
        "-sa",
        "-scc",
        "-scs",
        "-sdel",
        "-seml",
        "-sfx",
        "-slp",
        "-snh",
        "-snl",
        "-sni",
        "-sns",
        "-spd",
        "-spe",
        "-spf",
        "-ssc",
        "-sse",
        "-ssp",
        "-ssw",
        "-stl",
        "-stm",
        "-stx",
        "-u",
        "-v",
        "-w",
        "-ai",
        "-ax",
        "-i",
        "-x",
    )
    if lower in {"-bd", "-bt", "-an"} or lower.startswith(ignored_prefixes):
        return True
    return False


def parse_command(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[str, Options, list[str]]:
    if not argv:
        return "help", Options(), []
    first = argv[0]
    if first in HELP_SWITCHES:
        return "help", Options(), []
    if first.startswith("-"):
        fail_command_line(f"Unknown switch:\n{first}", show_banner=False)
    if first not in SUPPORTED_COMMANDS:
        print_banner()
        sys.stderr.write(f"\n\nCommand Line Error:\nUnsupported command:\n{first}\n")
        raise ExitSignal(7)
    options = Options()
    operands: list[str] = []
    for arg in argv[1:]:
        if not options.stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            operands.extend(read_listfile(arg[1:]))
            continue
        if not options.stop_switches and arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
            if parse_switch(arg, options):
                continue
            fail_command_line(f"Unknown switch:\n{arg}", show_banner=first not in {"help"})
        operands.append(arg)
    return first, options, operands


def command_list_like(command: str, options: Options, operands: list[str]) -> int:
    archive_name = require_archive_name(operands[0] if operands else None)
    filters = operands[1:]
    print_banner()
    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        sys.stdout.write("Scanning the drive for archives:\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"\nERROR: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{archive_name}\n")
        sys.stderr.write("\n\nSystem ERROR:\nerrno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        return 2
    sys.stdout.write("Scanning the drive for archives:\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"1 file, {size_text(os.path.getsize(archive_name))}\n\n")
    model = load_archive(archive_name, normalize_type(options.forced_type))
    if command == "l":
        sys.stdout.write(f"Listing archive: {archive_name}\n\n")
        print_archive_overview(model)
        print_list(model, filters, options.technical_list)
        return 0
    if command == "t":
        sys.stdout.write(f"Testing archive: {archive_name}\n")
        print_archive_overview(model)
        sys.stdout.write("\nEverything is Ok\n\n")
        folders, files, total_size, packed = count_extract_summary(model, filters)
        if model.type in {"gzip", "bzip2", "xz"}:
            sys.stdout.write(f"Size:       {total_size}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Compressed: {model.physical_size}\n")
        else:
            if folders:
                sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {folders}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {files}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Size:       {total_size}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Compressed: {model.physical_size}\n")
        return 0
    if command in {"x", "e"}:
        if options.write_stdout:
            model = load_archive(archive_name, normalize_type(options.forced_type))
            extract_members(model, command, options.output_dir, filters, options.assume_yes, True)
            return 0
        sys.stdout.write(f"Extracting archive: {archive_name}\n")
        print_archive_overview(model)
        sys.stdout.write("\n")
        extract_members(model, command, options.output_dir, filters, options.assume_yes, False)
        sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n\n")
        folders, files, total_size, packed = count_extract_summary(model, filters)
        if model.type in {"gzip", "bzip2", "xz"}:
            sys.stdout.write(f"Size:       {total_size}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Compressed: {model.physical_size}\n")
        else:
            sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {folders}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {files}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Size:       {total_size}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Compressed: {model.physical_size}\n")
        return 0
    raise AssertionError(command)


def run(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    command, options, operands = parse_command(argv)
    if command == "help":
        print_help()
        return 0
    if command == "i":
        print_info()
        return 0
    if command == "b":
        run_benchmark()
        return 0
    if command == "h":
        return run_hash(operands, options.hash_mode)
    if command in {"l", "t", "x", "e"}:
        return command_list_like(command, options, operands)
    if command in {"a", "u"}:
        archive_name = require_archive_name(operands[0] if operands else None)
        return run_add_like(command, archive_name, operands[1:], options)
    if command == "d":
        archive_name = require_archive_name(operands[0] if operands else None)
        return run_delete(archive_name, operands[1:], options)
    if command == "rn":
        archive_name = require_archive_name(operands[0] if operands else None)
        return run_rename(archive_name, operands[1:], options)
    fail_command_line(f"Unsupported command:\n{command}", show_banner=True)
    return 7


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
    try:
        return run(args)
    except ExitSignal as exc:
        return exc.code
